Due to a permanent infrastructure restriction, there is no direct route connecting Depot Alpha and Depot Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to a regulatory mandate, exactly one of the following two links must be part of the inspection tour: the route between Depot Beta and Depot Gamma, or the route between Depot Gamma and Depot Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed circuit that visits every depot precisely once and concludes at the initial depot.
